scope: Final independent free review including durable consent/sensitivity exclusions under extractor replacement. Earlier audit and all original failures remain separate.

findings.initially_reproduced: Two failures: immediate disabled ingest or queued event skipped while disabled reappeared after re-enable, restart and full SQLite rebuild.
findings.resolution: Parent added durable namespace/event event_projection tombstones at disabled ingest/queue processing and rejection in _process_event plus rebuild filtering. Original Event audit remains, projection permission does not revive.
findings.final_status: Verified by independent unit test, both immediate and deferred paths across restart/rebuild.

findings.initially_reproduced: Two failures: after soft/hard forget, changed extraction moved the same forgotten FACT into another memory index and rebuild made it retrievable again. Observation-only dialogue guards were insufficient.
findings.resolution: Parent added namespace/event/content memory_projection guard and a stable alternate identity for independent unforgotten candidates colliding with an old index tombstone. Legacy tombstones without source guards remain conservative.
findings.final_status: Verified by independent tests for both soft/hard forgetting, changed extraction and reversed facts across restart/full rebuild, retaining the independent unforgotten fact.
findings.limit: Guard matches source-scoped stripped original candidate text. It is not semantic detection of arbitrary paraphrases or facts restated in another event.

findings.initially_reproduced: Known user role aliases and normalized casing/spacing bypassed blocks_turn, permitting an explicit Do not remember turn to form an ordinary FACT.
findings.resolution: Parent normalized user/human/user_correction/memory_correction with strip/casefold before consent/sensitivity and observation handling.
findings.final_status: Five independent end-to-end alias cases pass. Full-turn sensitivity remains checked before clipping, base policy and fact extraction.

findings.initially_reproduced: Three additional failures after consent fix: spaced user, memory_correction and spaced assistant annotated unknown despite known source declarations.
findings.resolution: Parent reused the declared user-source set and strip/casefold in the provenance provider.
findings.final_status: All six role-to-view end-to-end cases pass without deriving a role from source text.

findings.discovery: Parent identified the residual policy-skip replay gap during code review. Independent isolated in-memory probe confirmed 0 initial memories becoming 1 FACT after removing retention and rebuilding, with event_projection_blocked=false.
findings.initially_reproduced: Two independent red cases: explicit optout or a synthetic sensitive label were initially excluded but reconstructed after restart with a replacement permissive extractor that lacks retention.
findings.resolution: Parent appended exclude_from_replay=False to ExtractionOutcome, set True only for whole-turn retention consent/sensitivity exclusions, and made service persist an event_projection block before recording the original POLICY_SKIP decision. Ordinary low-utility skips retain default False and remain replayable.
findings.final_status: Both new SQLite cases now pass across actual service close/reopen and full projection rebuild. Two matching PostgreSQL cases added; native execution still awaits CI.
findings.limit: Explicit policy exclusion blocks memory projection/replay, not the retained Event audit payload. Existing earlier events never marked by such a policy are not retroactively classified.

reviewed_invariants: Annotation verifies current namespace, version, lifecycle, complete source-ref set, cutoff and exact visible clip containment; it cannot widen the body.
Initial/search/read paths in the new reader explicitly annotate through the same provider; legacy readers do not implicitly gain annotations.
Statement clocks use event.observed_at, distinct from occurred/valid time; missing/foreign/future/tombstoned sources retain unknown stamps and hide their role/clock/message metadata.
Metadata provider never accesses payload.text in business logic. get_event still loads the whole Event through the store; no metadata-only database projection is claimed.
Source-forget eviction and tombstones are inside the outer public-store transaction. SQLite rollback checks pass; PostgreSQL native rollback tests remain to execute remotely.
Full-turn observations remain OBSERVATION episodes, without promoted value; identical words at different events do not merge their event identity.
A forgotten previously-discovered source cannot be re-read/reannotated or recovered by search after rebuild.
retained_source_span describes stored retention only; displayed_chars measures the actual current clip. No original-body extension or invented truncation marker is added.
Legacy/adaptive reader, default service, edge cases, episodic and narrative policy regression tests are included in the final free verification.
Explicit optout/sensitive user-turn rejection is durable even if a later extractor does not install DialogueRetentionPolicy; ordinary utility filtering is not made permanent.

postgres.reason: DIVE_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN is absent; collection and conditional skipping are not database validation.
postgres.new_cases: Soft/hard FACT candidate reordering with independent unforgotten candidate returned, five user aliases honoring explicit optout, and immediate/deferred disabled event reprocessing after re-enable.
postgres.required_remaining_verification: Execute all 15 in the native PostgreSQL CI service on the exact final published SHA, with zero skips.
postgres.additional_cases: Explicit optout and synthetic sensitive-label exclusions remain blocked on original-event reprocessing under a replacement extractor.

limitations: This review is free engineering evidence; no new Oracle answers, original-judge verdicts or score increase were produced.
Raw Event audit is retained for disabled/opt-out turns unless a separate event hard-forget workflow removes it. This is projection exclusion, not erasure of original audit payload.
Current full benchmark remains R62 435 correct/57 wrong/8 unknown; R67 pilot remained 91/8/1 and did not authorize the full run.
Full engineering quality gate and fresh wheel/native PostgreSQL CI are owned by parent and still require their own exact-source evidence.
